name: grouped-list
title: Grouped list
description: A long list under sticky group headers (days, letters, teams) with counts and an optional A to Z jump rail.
docs: Give it groups of items, a renderItem function and a height such as h-96, because it scrolls inside. The id of a group can be a date: pass getGroupLabel to write it as Today or Yesterday. Turn on indexRail for alphabetical lists; groups with no items are left out, so the rail has no empty letters. The rail is one Tab stop: Up, Down, Home and End walk its letters, Enter or Space jump. Each button is 24 pixels tall, so give the list about 24 pixels per group (h-[34rem] for A to Z) or the rail scrolls.
